# Google Search Console / Site Verification responses

Recorded from the real APIs during the L11 account-model proof on `https://e2eteststarter.vercel.app/`,
2026-11-13, signed in as the JDD Workspace account. Owner email addresses are replaced with
`owner-1@example.com` / `owner-2@example.com`; nothing else is edited. Status codes are in each file.

Don't hand-write a response here. A fixture encodes what Google actually did, and the teardown
order in `lib/search-console.js` rests on `relinquish-while-token-served.json`.
